products.name: Linen camp-collar shirt
products.short: A relaxed camp-collar shirt in washed linen that softens with every wear.
description: Cut boxy and a little short, to wear open over a tee or buttoned on its own. The linen is washed before it’s sewn, so it’s soft from the first day and won’t shrink.
Camp collar and a straight hem
Relaxed fit: take your usual size

products.name: Relaxed Oxford shirt
products.short: Our everyday Oxford, cut a little roomier, with a button-down collar.
description: The cotton Oxford weave is soft but sturdy, and the shirt is long enough to tuck in. A box pleat at the back gives you room to move.
Box pleat and a locker loop at the back

products.name: Pleated midi skirt
products.short: A swishy midi skirt with knife pleats and an elastic back waist.
description: Falls to mid-calf and moves well. The pleats are pressed in for good, so it comes out of the wash ready to wear.

specs.Care: Machine wash cold, hang to dry

products.name: Striped cotton-knit jumper
products.short: A relaxed jumper in a chunky waffle knit, in soft cotton that breathes.
description: We knit it in a deep waffle stitch, so it holds its shape and keeps a little air in. The fit is relaxed through the body, with dropped shoulders and a hem that sits at the hip.
The model is 5′9″ and wears M
Take your usual size for a relaxed fit, or one size down for a closer fit.

products.name: Organic cotton tee
products.short: The tee we wear most: organic cotton, a clean crew neck and a fit that keeps its shape.
description: Made from heavy organic cotton jersey that gets softer, not thinner. Pre-shrunk, so the size you buy is the size you keep.
Crew neck with a narrow rib
Side seams, so it hangs straight

products.name: Everyday tee, pack of three
products.short: Three organic cotton tees in white, grey and navy, for less than the price of three.
description: Our organic cotton tee in the three colours you reach for most, folded together in one recycled paper sleeve.
One white, one grey and one navy tee

products.name: Merino crew jumper
products.short: A fine-gauge merino crew that’s warm without weight and never itches.
description: Extra-fine merino from Australia, knitted thin enough to wear under a coat or over a shirt.

specs.Care: Hand wash cold or wool cycle

products.name: Chunky rib-knit sweater
products.short: A thick, slouchy rib-knit for the coldest mornings.
description: Knitted from a soft wool and cotton blend in a deep rib that holds warmth. Long enough to cover your hips.

products.name: Straight-leg jeans
products.short: Mid-rise jeans with a straight leg, in a rigid denim that softens as you wear it.
description: A classic five-pocket jean in 13 oz cotton denim with a little stretch. The leg falls straight from the hip.

products.name: Belted wrap coat
products.short: A long wrap coat in a soft wool blend, with a tie belt and deep pockets.
description: Unlined so it drapes, with a shawl collar and a belt you can tie at the front or the back.

products.name: Wool-blend blazer
products.short: A single-breasted blazer that works with jeans as well as it does with trousers.
description: Half-lined and lightly structured, with two flap pockets and a single vent.

products.name: Cable-knit beanie
products.short: A deep cable-knit beanie with a turn-up, in soft lambswool.
description: Deep enough to cover your ears with the turn-up down. Lambswool, so it stays warm when it’s damp.

products.name: Brass-buckle leather belt
products.short: A full-grain leather belt with a solid brass buckle that will outlast your jeans.
description: Cut from a single piece of vegetable-tanned leather that darkens and softens with wear.

products.name: Leather bifold wallet
products.short: A slim bifold with six card slots and room for notes, in soft brown leather.
description: Slim enough for a front pocket. The leather is soft from day one and gets better with age.
Six card slots and a note pocket

products.name: Gold bangle set of three
products.short: Three slim bangles to wear together or on their own.
description: Brass with a thick gold plating that won’t rub off, in three textures: smooth, twisted and hammered.

products.name: Layered gold necklace
products.short: Two fine chains on one clasp, so they never tangle.
description: A short chain and a long one, joined at the clasp. Gold vermeil on sterling silver.

products.name: Crescent moon bracelet
products.short: A fine chain bracelet with a small crescent moon charm.
description: Delicate enough to wear every day, with an adjustable chain that fits most wrists.

products.name: Maple wood watch
products.short: A light maple case with a cream dial and a soft leather strap.
description: The case is cut from a single block of maple, so it weighs almost nothing on your wrist.

products.name: Black canvas-strap watch
products.short: A clean white dial on a black case, with a tough canvas strap.
description: Simple to read at a glance, with a quiet movement and a strap you can swap in seconds.

products.name: Gold-frame aviator sunglasses
products.short: Classic aviators with a light gold frame and grey lenses.
description: Polarised lenses cut the glare off water and roads, and block 100% of UVA and UVB.

products.name: Lilac-lens sunglasses
products.short: Square frames with soft lilac lenses that make everything look like early evening.
description: Lightweight acetate frames and tinted lenses with full UV protection.

products.name: Mesh trail runner
products.short: A light trail runner with a grippy sole and a breathable knit upper.
description: Comfortable from the first run, with a cushioned sole that grips on gravel and wet paths.

products.name: Rope toe-post sandals
products.short: Toe-post sandals with a braided rope sole and soft suede straps.
description: A braided jute sole with a rubber base, so they last on pavements as well as the beach.
Braided jute sole with a rubber base

products.name: Leather chukka boots
products.short: Two-eyelet chukkas in soft leather, on a crepe sole.
description: Smart enough for work and easy enough for the weekend. The crepe sole is light and quiet.

products.name: Quilted top-handle bag
products.short: A soft quilted bag with two top handles and a long strap.
description: Big enough for a tablet and a book, with a zip pocket inside for keys.
Two handles and a long detachable strap

products.name: Black structured handbag
products.short: A structured leather handbag with a top handle and a slim front pocket.
description: Holds its shape when it’s empty and closes with a magnetic flap.
Top handles and a detachable strap

products.name: Waxed leather messenger bag
products.short: A waxed leather messenger with a padded laptop sleeve and brass buckles.
description: Fits a 15-inch laptop, with a wide strap that sits well on the shoulder.

products.name: Coral padlock handbag
products.short: A small structured bag in coral with a gold padlock charm.
description: Just big enough for the essentials, with a long strap to wear it across the body.

products.name: Striped beach tote
products.short: A roomy canvas tote in bold stripes, for the beach and the market.
description: Heavy cotton canvas with rope handles and an inside pocket for your phone.

products.name: Leather weekend duffel
products.short: A soft leather duffel that holds a weekend and fits under a plane seat.
description: Waxed leather that only gets better with knocks, with a zip pocket for shoes.
Shoe pocket and an inside zip pocket

products.name: Mint on-ear headphones
products.short: Light wireless on-ears with a 40-hour battery, in soft colours.
description: They fold flat, charge in two hours and last a week of commuting.

products.name: Petal on-ear headphones
products.short: Cushioned wireless headphones with a warm sound and a 30-hour battery.
description: Memory-foam cushions, easy buttons on the ear cup and a cable for when the battery runs out.

products.name: Cube desk speakers, pair
products.short: A pair of small cube speakers with a big sound for a desk or a shelf.
description: Plug them into your computer by USB-C or play from your phone over Bluetooth.

products.name: Pebble mini speaker
products.short: A palm-size speaker that floats, with 12 hours of battery.
description: Waterproof and dustproof, with a strap to hang it in the shower or from a bag.

products.name: Compact mechanical keyboard
products.short: A tenkeyless mechanical keyboard with quiet switches and a solid aluminium case.
description: Quiet tactile switches, keys you can swap, and a cable or Bluetooth for up to three devices.

products.name: Silent wireless mouse
products.short: A quiet mouse that fits either hand and runs for a year on one battery.
description: Silent buttons, a smooth scroll wheel and a small receiver that stores inside it.

products.name: Balance arm desk lamp
products.short: A black steel desk lamp with a counterweighted arm and a brass knob.
description: The arm stays where you put it, and the warm LED bulb is included.

products.name: Slim power bank
products.short: A 10,000 mAh power bank as thin as a phone, with fast USB-C charging.
description: Charges a phone twice over and charges itself in three hours.

products.name: Activity band
products.short: Counts steps, sleep and heart rate, and lasts ten days between charges.
description: A light band with a bright screen, notifications from your phone and water resistance for swimming.

products.name: Speckled stoneware mug
products.short: A hand-glazed stoneware mug with a speckled finish and a generous handle.
description: Each one is glazed by hand, so the speckles are never quite the same.

products.name: Stoneware mugs, set of two
products.short: Two plain white stoneware mugs that stack neatly in the cupboard.
description: Heavy enough to keep coffee warm, light enough to drink from all morning.

products.name: Drip-glaze bud vase
products.short: A small stoneware vase with a blue drip glaze over a sandy clay.
description: Made for a single stem or a small bunch. The glaze runs differently on every vase.

products.name: Pale celadon vase
products.short: A round vase with a pale celadon glaze and a short neck.
description: A quiet shape that looks good with flowers in it or without.

products.name: Ceramic table lamp
products.short: A white ceramic lamp with a pleated linen shade.
description: A soft, warm light for a side table or a bedside.

products.name: Woven texture cushions, pair
products.short: Two cushion covers in a hand-woven wool and cotton, with a fringe.
description: Woven on looms in Portugal from wool and cotton. Inserts not included.

products.name: Honeycomb cushion cover
products.short: A cushion cover in a deep honeycomb knit.
description: Knitted from soft cotton in a raised honeycomb stitch. Insert not included.

products.name: Leather butterfly chair
products.short: A leather sling on a folding steel frame: the chair everyone sits in first.
description: Vegetable-tanned leather that softens and darkens with use, on a black steel frame that folds flat.

products.name: Soy wax candle, fig & cedar
products.short: A slow-burning soy candle that smells of ripe figs and cedar wood.
description: Hand-poured soy wax and a cotton wick, in a glass you can use again.

products.name: Satin lipstick trio
products.short: Three satin lipsticks in a red, a rose and a berry.
description: Creamy colour that lasts through lunch, and never dries your lips.

products.name: Lipstick set of six
products.short: Six satin lipsticks from soft coral to deep red, in one box.
description: Every shade you need for a year, packed in a recycled card box.

products.name: Nail colour duo
products.short: A pair of quick-dry nail colours, in a soft pink and a deep red.
description: Glossy colour in two coats, dry in a minute.

products.name: Brightening face serum
products.short: A light serum with vitamin C to even out your skin.
description: Absorbs in seconds and sits well under make-up. Use it in the morning, before sunscreen.

products.name: Botanical face oil
products.short: A calendula face oil that calms dry skin overnight.
description: Cold-pressed oils with calendula, for dry or tired skin. A few drops at night are enough.

products.name: Sea glass eau de parfum
products.short: Fresh and salty: sea air, bergamot and a little cedar.
description: A clean, airy scent that lasts all day without filling the room.

products.name: Wildflower eau de toilette
products.short: Light and green: cut grass, chamomile and white flowers.
description: A gentle scent for warm days, made in small batches in Grasse.

striped-jumper: Soft, thick and not itchy at all. I took my usual M and it’s relaxed, exactly like the photos.
Bought the navy and went back for the oat. Washed both twice and they kept their shape.
Lovely knit. The sleeves are a little long on me, but I like pushing them up.
Warm enough for a cool morning without a coat.
cotton-tee: The best basic tee I own. Heavy, soft, and still the right size after twenty washes.
Great tee. The white needs a vest underneath for me, the colours don’t.
I own it in four colours now. That says it all.
tee-pack: Three good tees for the price of two. The navy is a proper deep navy.
Fit is spot on and they don’t twist after washing.
Really good value. I wish there was a black pack too.
linen-shirt: Soft right out of the bag. I wear it open over a tee all summer.
Boxy and short, as it says. I sized down and it’s perfect.
oxford-shirt: Proper Oxford cloth, and the collar rolls nicely.
Roomy fit, as promised. The pale blue is my favourite.
merino-crew: Fine, warm and not a hint of itch. I wear it under my coat every day.
The cranberry is a beautiful colour in person.
chunky-sweater: Thick and cosy, and long enough to wear with leggings.
Oversized indeed: I sized down one.
straight-jeans: Stiff for a week, then perfect. The straight leg is just right.
Good jeans. The 32 inside leg is a touch long for me, easy to turn up.
leather-belt: Solid buckle, thick leather. It’ll last longer than I will.
Sized exactly as the guide said.
wood-watch: So light I forget I’m wearing it, and people always ask about it.
Bought it as a gift and then bought one for myself.
The strap was stiff for a few days, then it moulded to my wrist.
botanical-oil: My dry patches were gone in a week. A little goes a long way.
Smells like a garden and sinks in overnight.
The only face oil that doesn’t break me out.
honeycomb-cushion: The texture is lovely and it washes well.
Bought two for the sofa and they look expensive.
petal-headphones: Comfortable for a whole flight and the battery lasted the trip back too.
Warm, full sound. A little snug on big ears.
mint-headphones: The colour is even nicer in person, and they last all week.
Light and comfy. Not the deepest bass, but great for podcasts.
cube-speakers: Much bigger sound than they look. Perfect for my desk.
Easy to set up over USB-C. The walnut looks great.
speckled-mug: The perfect size for a big coffee, and every one is a little different.
Bought one, came back for four more.
soy-candle: Smells like a fig tree in the sun. Burns evenly to the end.
My favourite candle, and the glass makes a nice pot afterwards.
bangle-set: I wear all three together every day and the gold hasn’t faded.
Pretty and light. A little big on my small wrists.
chukka-boots: Comfortable from the first day, and the crepe sole is so quiet.
True to size. They look better with every wear.
coral-runner: Light and grippy on the trail. Runs a little narrow.
My new favourite running shoe. The coral is bright in the best way.
quilted-tote: Light, holds my laptop and a lunch, and the long strap is handy.
messenger-bag: Beautiful leather and it fits my 15-inch laptop with room to spare.
aviators: Classic look and the polarised lenses really help when driving.
lilac-sunglasses: Everything looks like golden hour. I love them.
tkl-keyboard: Quiet enough for the office and lovely to type on.
wireless-mouse: Truly silent clicks. My partner thanks you.
glazed-vase: The glaze is gorgeous. Mine has a lovely deep blue drip.
teal-perfume: Fresh and clean. I wish it lasted a little longer on me.
lipstick-trio: All three shades suit me, and they don’t dry my lips.
